findings.detail: An empty PATH bypasses locking but still runs the default full suite. For example, make test-scrut SCRUT_TEST_DIR= passes an empty argument. The wrapper replaces its default path with that empty string, fails the directory test and delegates directly. The coordinator then expands the empty path back to tests/scrut/. This permits a full run alongside another heavy suite. Apply the coordinator's default-path normalization before deciding whether to lock.
findings.evidence: bin/run-scrut-documents:15 assigns the empty argument to path; lines 18–21 delegate without run-heavy-suite. bin/lib/run-scrut-documents:289 applies path="${path:-${DEFAULT_PATH}}". Makefile:218 passes SCRUT_TEST_DIR as a quoted argument. The omitted-path and empty-path forms therefore execute the same directory with different locking.
findings.title: Sibling input forms: an empty path runs the default suite without locking

findings.detail: The adoption leaves the snapshot-update entry point unprotected. With its default directory, make test-scrut-update executes every document through bin/run-scrut before reaching the locked verification command. That first full-suite execution can overlap another heavy suite, contrary to the new automatic-lock guidance. Include directory update runs in the locking policy while preserving direct named-document runs.
findings.evidence: Makefile:224 invokes bin/run-scrut --shell bash update over SCRUT_TEST_DIR, whose default is tests/scrut/. bin/run-scrut only resets the environment and execs scrut. The lock is reached afterward at Makefile:225. tests/AGENTS.md:13–15 says full suites and Scrut directory runs automatically take the heavy lock.
findings.title: Parallel paths: directory snapshot updates execute before taking the heavy lock

findings.detail: The runtime guidance still directs readers to the public coordinator's header for discovery, output ordering and exit behavior. That header moved into bin/lib/run-scrut-documents; the public wrapper now contains only a one-line lock-selection comment. Update the reference to the implementation header.
findings.evidence: tests/AGENTS.md:25 names ../bin/run-scrut-documents and says its header describes listing, output ordering and exits. Those descriptions now reside in bin/lib/run-scrut-documents:2–23.
findings.title: Docs drift: runtime guidance points to the coordinator header's former location
